posts.title: Creating Tik Tok, but for churches at Divining.app #BuildInPublic
posts.description: I have been working on a project since 2017 that turns all the sermons from liberal churches in the US into a website people can explore, and a collection researchers can study on archive.org. The pipeline begins with discovery, then transcription and topic tagging, and archiving the audio with each transcript in a searchable way. […]

posts.title: The high cost to society of not belonging
posts.description: A seminal bit of research was released in 2023 on the State of Belonging in America that showed just how much civic and philanthropic prosocial behavior stops when people feel like they don’t belong in their community.
